action.content: Write a cover letter for a job at a local coffee shop in the form of a poem. Highlight at least 5 text sections using "*". For example: *3 years of experience*.
action.label: context

action.content:
To the Barista Who Keeps the Roast Alive,

I write this verse to apply for your crew,
With a heart that beats to the morning brew.
Though I may not know the exact grind size,
I bring a passion that will never cease.

*3 years of experience* in serving smiles,
Is something I offer, not just for miles.
I know how to steam milk with a gentle hand,
And keep the espresso machine from standing.

My *attention to detail* is sharp and keen,
I'll ensure every cup is perfectly clean.
From wiping down counters to polishing rings,
I'll make your busy shop feel like a spring.

I understand that *customer service* is key,
To making every guest feel free.
I'll listen to their orders with a warm, bright eye,
And watch the coffee steam rise to the sky.

Even when the rush is loud and fast,
I'll keep my cool and do my best.
With *positive energy* that I will share,
I'll make your coffee shop a place to care.

So let me pour my heart into this line,
And hope I can be part of your design.
I'm ready to start my shift today,
And help you serve the best way.

Sincerely,

A Future Barista||
